items.title: Approve the Minutes of the June 9, 2020 Meeting
Appoint Rachel Zack to the Citizens Advisory Committee
Final Approval Revise the Amended Fiscal Year 2019/20 Budget to Decrease Revenues by $33.4 Million and Decrease Expenditures by $5.0 Million for a Total Net Decrease in Fund Balance of $28.4 Million
Adopt the Proposed Provisional Three-Month Fiscal Year 2020/21 Budget and Work Program
Allocate $566,800, With Conditions, and Appropriate $100,000 in Prop K Sales Tax Funds for Three Requests
Amend the 2017 Prop AA Strategic Plan

Increase the Amount of the Professional Services Contract with NelsonNygaard Consulting Associates by 775,000, to a Total Amount Not to Exceed $1,475,000, and Extend the Contract Term Through March 31, 2021, for Technical and Communications Services for the Downtown Congestion Pricing Study
Adopt the District 3 Pedestrian Safety Improvements Final Report NTIP Planning
Presentation on the San Francisco Municipal Transportation Agency’s Transportation Recovery Plan
